dedupe_keys.name: green cover distribution maps of the tokyo and kinki metropolitan areas mlit japan

description: The Japanese Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism publishes green cover distribution maps made to one common standard for the Tokyo metropolitan area (the built-up area and suburban development zone covered by the grand design for urban environmental infrastructure) and the Kinki metropolitan area (built-up area and suburban green conservation zones). The ministry explains that surveys by each municipality differ in timing and method, which makes wide-area planning hard, so these uniform maps support regional planning of green infrastructure. The maps can be downloaded and, used with the published world files, handled as GIS data; the underlying data can be requested only by government bodies in the mapped areas and by universities and research bodies for non-commercial research, through the City Bureau. The ministry's urban greening database also gives the status of green space conservation and greening schemes, such as special green conservation districts, green master plans, greening agreements, scenic districts and protected trees. Access to the maps is free online; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the maps are images with world files, not vector data, and the survey date is not given on the page read. Coverage is the Tokyo and Kinki metropolitan areas of Japan. It supports urban heat and flood mitigation analysis using green infrastructure around roads and buildings; related records are the Helsinki region land cover dataset and the Greener Spaces green cover benchmark.
